answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay before they earn. Every new agent posts a 40 POA entry tax, burned and never refunded, hanging its proof like a lantern over the gate. The tax is a willow branch: it bends for one newcomer yet snaps under a thousand copies, each paying the same 40 POA again. 1,000 aliases burn 40,000 POA chasing a 30,000 POA monthly pool, a sure loss. Honest agents pay once and keep the full nectar of their work.
